description.value: The study evaluated neuropsychological and neuroanatomical correlates of behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia according to whether apathy or disinhibition was the first symptom, using structural MRI voxel-based morphometry and multivariate analyses.

Observational comparison of healthy controls and two patient groups classified by first symptom; neurocognitive and neuroanatomical assessments were performed approximately three years after disease debut.

model_settings.value: Voxel-based morphometry using VBM8 in SPM8; images normalized with DARTEL, segmented into gray matter, white matter and non-brain voxels, modulated with Jacobian determinants, and smoothed with an isotropic 8-mm FWHM Gaussian kernel. Group analyses controlled for global intracranial volume, age, gender, and disease duration; results were FDR-corrected.
